`s ↦ γ.extend (min s t)` from `a` to `γ t` (`initialSegmentFamily_apply`). At `t = 0` this is
the constant path at `a` (`initialSegmentFamily_zero`); at `t = 1` it is `γ` itself, up to a
trivial right-endpoint cast (`initialSegmentFamily_one`). The property consumers actually need
is joint continuity in `(t, s)`, recorded as `continuous_initialSegmentFamily_uncurry`.
decls.statement:
def initialSegmentFamily {a b : X} (γ : Path a b) (t : I) :
    Path a (γ t)

decls.name: Path.continuous_initialSegmentFamily_uncurry
decls.statement:
theorem continuous_initialSegmentFamily_uncurry {a b : X} (γ : Path a b) :
    Continuous ↿(initialSegmentFamily γ)

decls.name: Path.initialSegmentFamily_apply
decls.statement:
theorem initialSegmentFamily_apply {a b : X} (γ : Path a b) (t s : I) :
    initialSegmentFamily γ t s = γ.extend (min (s : ℝ) t)

decls.name: Path.initialSegmentFamily_zero
decls.statement:
theorem initialSegmentFamily_zero {a b : X} (γ : Path a b) :
    initialSegmentFamily γ 0 = (Path.refl a).cast rfl (by simp)

decls.name: Path.initialSegmentFamily_one
decls.statement:
theorem initialSegmentFamily_one {a b : X} (γ : Path a b) :
    initialSegmentFamily γ 1 = γ.cast rfl (by simp)

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.Quotient.instTopologicalSpace
decls.doc:
The quotient topology on path-homotopy classes. This instance is load-bearing:
`Path.Homotopic.Quotient` is a `def` over `Quotient`, and instance search does not unfold it to
find the generic `TopologicalSpace (Quotient _)`.
decls.statement:
instance instTopologicalSpace (x₀ x : X) :
    TopologicalSpace (Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x)

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.Quotient.isOpen_iff_preimage_mk
decls.doc:
A set of path-homotopy classes is open exactly when its preimage under quotient
construction is open.
decls.statement:
theorem isOpen_iff_preimage_mk {x₀ x₁ : X} {S : Set (Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x₁)} :
    IsOpen S ↔ IsOpen ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk : Path x₀ x₁ →
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x₁) ⁻¹' S)

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.Quotient.subpath_trans
decls.doc:
In the path-homotopy quotient, concatenating adjacent subpaths of `p` gives the larger
subpath from the first endpoint to the last endpoint.
decls.statement:
theorem subpath_trans {x y : X} (p : Path x y) (a b c : unitInterval) :
    trans (mk (p.subpath a b)) (mk (p.subpath b c)) =
      mk (p.subpath a c)

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.Quotient.subpath_self
decls.doc: A degenerate subpath represents the reflexivity class at its endpoint.
decls.statement:
theorem subpath_self {x y : X} (p : Path x y) (a : unitInterval) :
    mk (p.subpath a a) = refl (p a)

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.Quotient.subpath_zero_one
decls.doc:
The full `[0,1]` subpath represents the original path, up to the endpoint casts inserted by
`Path.subpath`.
decls.statement:
theorem subpath_zero_one {x y : X} (p : Path x y) :
    mk (p.subpath 0 1) = (mk p).cast (by simp) (by simp)

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.trans_left_of_nullhomotopic
decls.doc: Composing on the left with a null-homotopic loop does not change the homotopy class.
decls.statement:
theorem trans_left_of_nullhomotopic {γ₀ : Path x₀ x₀} {γ₁ : Path x₀ x₁}
    (hγ₀ : γ₀.Homotopic (Path.refl x₀)) : (γ₀.trans γ₁).Homotopic γ₁

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.trans_right_of_nullhomotopic
decls.doc: Composing on the right with a null-homotopic loop does not change the homotopy class.
decls.statement:
theorem trans_right_of_nullhomotopic {γ₀ : Path x₀ x₁} {γ₁ : Path x₁ x₁}
    (hγ₁ : γ₁.Homotopic (Path.refl x₁)) : (γ₀.trans γ₁).Homotopic γ₀

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.of_trans_symm
decls.doc:
If `γ.trans γ'.symm` is nullhomotopic, then `γ` and `γ'` are homotopic.
This is the path-homotopy analogue of `a * b⁻¹ = 1 → a = b`.
decls.statement:
theorem of_trans_symm {γ γ' : Path x₀ x₁}
    (h : (γ.trans γ'.symm).Homotopic (Path.refl x₀)) : γ.Homotopic γ'

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.trans_right_cancel
decls.doc:
Right cancellation in the fundamental groupoid: if `γ.trans e` and `δ.trans e` are homotopic,
then `γ` and `δ` are homotopic. This is the path-homotopy analogue of `a * c = b * c → a = b`.
decls.statement:
theorem trans_right_cancel {x₀ x₁ x₂ : X} {γ δ : Path x₀ x₁} {e : Path x₁ x₂}
    (h : (γ.trans e).Homotopic (δ.trans e)) : γ.Homotopic δ

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.trans_left_cancel
decls.doc:
Left cancellation in the fundamental groupoid: if `e.trans γ` and `e.trans δ` are homotopic,
then `γ` and `δ` are homotopic. This is the path-homotopy analogue of `c * a = c * b → a = b`.
decls.statement:
theorem trans_left_cancel {x₀ x₁ x₂ : X} {e : Path x₀ x₁} {γ δ : Path x₁ x₂}
    (h : (e.trans γ).Homotopic (e.trans δ)) : γ.Homotopic δ

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.map_nullhomotopic_of_nullhomotopic
decls.doc:
The image of a based loop under a null-homotopic continuous map is null-homotopic in the
target: a map homotopic to a constant collapses every loop to the constant loop.

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_cast
decls.doc: Casting the reflexivity class at `x` along `h : y = x` gives the reflexivity class at `y`.
decls.statement: theorem refl_cast {x y : X} (h : y = x) : (refl x).cast h h = refl y

decls.name: Path.Homotopic.Quotient.eq_of_trans_symm
decls.doc:
If `trans γ (symm γ') = refl`, then `γ = γ'`.
This is the quotient analogue of `eq_of_div_eq_one : a / b = 1 → a = b`.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_of_trans_symm {γ γ' : Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x₁}
    (h : trans γ (symm γ') = refl x₀) : γ = γ'

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.germSection
decls.doc: A section of a presheaf, viewed as a section of the étalé projection.

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.base_germSection
decls.statement:
theorem base_germSection (U : Opens X) (s : ToType (F.obj (Opposite.op U))) (x : U) :
    (germSection F U s x).base = x

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.germ_germSection
decls.statement:
theorem germ_germSection (U : Opens X) (s : ToType (F.obj (Opposite.op U))) (x : U) :
    cast (congrArg (fun y : X ↦ ToType (F.stalk y)) (base_germSection U s x))
      (germSection F U s x).germ = F.germ U x x.2 s

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.sectionRange
decls.doc: The open set in the étalé space swept out by the germs of a section.
decls.statement:
def sectionRange (F : X.Presheaf C) (U : Opens X) (s : ToType (F.obj (Opposite.op U))) :
    Set F.EtaleSpace

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.mem_sectionRange_iff
decls.doc:
Membership in the range of a germ section means being the germ of that section at the
underlying base point.

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.isOpen_sectionRange
decls.doc: The germs of a section form an open subset of the étalé space.
decls.statement:
theorem isOpen_sectionRange (U : Opens X) (s : ToType (F.obj (Opposite.op U))) :
    IsOpen (sectionRange F U s)

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.germSection_injective
decls.doc: A germ section is injective because the étalé projection recovers its argument.
decls.statement:
theorem germSection_injective (U : Opens X) (s : ToType (F.obj (Opposite.op U))) :
    Function.Injective (germSection F U s)

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.continuous_germSection
decls.doc: The map taking a point to the germ of a fixed section there is continuous.
decls.statement:
theorem continuous_germSection (U : Opens X) (s : ToType (F.obj (Opposite.op U))) :
    Continuous (germSection F U s)

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.isOpenEmbedding_germSection
decls.doc: A germ section is an open embedding of its domain into the étalé space.
decls.statement:
theorem isOpenEmbedding_germSection (U : Opens X) (s : ToType (F.obj (Opposite.op U))) :
    Topology.IsOpenEmbedding (germSection F U s)

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.sectionOpenPartialHomeomorph
decls.doc:
The local chart on the étalé space determined by a section of a presheaf.

On `sectionRange F U s`, the chart is the étalé projection to `U`; its inverse sends a point
to the germ of `s` at that point.

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.sectionOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply
decls.doc: On its source, the chart determined by a section agrees with the étalé projection.
decls.statement:
theorem sectionOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply (F : X.Presheaf C) (U : Opens X)
    (s : ToType (F.obj (Opposite.op U))) (x₀ : U) {g : F.EtaleSpace}
    (hg : g ∈ sectionRange F U s) :
    sectionOpenPartialHomeomorph F U s x₀ g = g.base

decls.name: TauCeti.TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.isLocalHomeomorph_base
decls.doc: The projection from the étalé space of a presheaf to the base is a local homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem isLocalHomeomorph_base (F : X.Presheaf C) :
    IsLocalHomeomorph (TopCat.Presheaf.EtaleSpace.base (F := F))

decls.name: TauCeti.IsTriangulable
decls.doc:
A topological space is triangulable if it is homeomorphic to the geometric realization of an
abstract simplicial complex.
decls.statement: def IsTriangulable.{v, u} (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.isTriangulable_realization
decls.doc: The geometric realization of every abstract simplicial complex is triangulable.
decls.statement:
theorem isTriangulable_realization (K : AbstractSimplicialComplex ι) :
    IsTriangulable.{u} (Realization K)

decls.name: Homeomorph.isTriangulable_iff
decls.doc: Homeomorphic spaces are triangulable simultaneously.
decls.statement:
theorem _root_.Homeomorph.isTriangulable_iff (e : X ≃ₜ Y) :
    IsTriangulable.{v} X ↔ IsTriangulable.{v} Y

decls.name: TauCeti.isTriangulable_of_discreteTopology
decls.doc:
Every discrete topological space is triangulable, using the bottom abstract simplicial
complex on its points.
decls.statement:
theorem isTriangulable_of_discreteTopology (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X]
    [DiscreteTopology X] : IsTriangulable.{u} X
